title: Grade XI Physics – Unit 2: Vectors
limitations: All 206 MCQs were programmatically extracted from the complete user-provided Stage 6 final QC Word tables, retaining source question/option wording, answer keys and explanations.
The 6 textbook exercise MCQs are numbered separately from the 200 additional MCQs, as in the source; stable IDs preserve their distinction.
The 60 additional scenario MCQs form 15 intact groups of four and retain the original shared stimulus passages.
Original Stage 6 final QC applies to its source document, but this digital import needs live display/scoring and spot academic verification before broad student rollout.
Cognitive/difficulty labels are provisional automated practice aids; do not treat them as official FBISE per-item classifications.
All questions are summative-aligned by the verified Unit 2 B-01/B-02 source grouping; exact individual SLO mappings and textbook pages of additional questions still need review.
All questions boardEligible=false; this is PUBLIC self-practice with answers, not a secure board examination or premium-only bank.

Four additional MCQs (#4, #13, #15 and #153) depend on a preceding question in the source; the required contextual data is now repeated as a standalone stimulus so random practice remains answerable. Original stems, choices, answers and explanations are unchanged.
